description: Property level energy consumption (modelled on building attributes) - baseline 2011 and business as usual projections 2016-2026 is a dataset listed in City of Melbourne open data portal (data.melbourne.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. This dataset should be read alongside other energy consumption datasets on the City of Melbourne open data platform as well as the following report: vic. gov. au/uploads/Meeting%20Agendas/2014%20August/Att%207aIMAPEnergyMap-CSIRO-EnergyUse2011-2026Report-2014June30-Finalpdf11. 2MB. pdf The dataset outlines modelled energy consumption across the City of Melbourne municipality. Coverage: City of Melbourne, Australia. The portal files it under the publisher data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. Its tags are building managment, buildings, cityreactivation, climate, electricity. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, json, geojson. The portal shows 2023-02-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melbourne-vic-gov-au-portal.
